text: Beware, the doctors lie to you at this clinic.  I recently went down for 3 weeks of treatment for breast cancer. Even though I told them I didn't want their chemo treatment, they assured me it would be really helpful, they would only be using 10% and I would not lose my hair. They lied. I lost all of my hair which started 1 week after I returned home. When contacting my doctor he told me that was so unusual and recommended Minoxidal (which actually makes your hair shed worse before it regrows).  This happened to 2 other women I kept in contact with. So it wasn't that unusual. When I followed up to find out what they gave me, it was the MOST toxic of all the chemotherapy treatments and they gave me a 50% dose, not 10%. It makes me question everything they are administering here.  It has been extremely stressful which is opposite from what I need healing cancer. I am guessing they push chemo so much because they want results. I later found out the type of cancer I have, isn't responsive to chemotherapy. I would have hoped a clinic like this would have tests to check this. The total disrespect for me to make an informed decision makes me motivated to share my story to help protect others. I regret going here. Spend your money with doctors who are honest. I will say that the nurses were spectacular. They deserve a 10 star rating. But the doctors deserve a -10 for taking advantage of their patients at their most vulnerable.

text: This was my husbands 5th trip to ITC.  He goes annually for check-ups and to get an "immune boost"! He is always treated like family and gets quality care. We are happy with all aspects of ITC but above all we are happy with the results of his treatments!

text: The ITC doctors, nurses, and staff were absolutely phenomenal. I was given specialized and personalized care not only for the three weeks I received therapy at their facility, but also in the months that followed as I continued home therapy. These people are in the business of caring for those with sickness and they do it with compassion and wisdom. Their confidence is encouraging and I have seen a complete turn around in my health.
